text:
Travelers: confirm companion animal requirements before check-in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. For safe handling and on-time boarding, please review crate and age rules now.

Aurelia Skyways sets the youngest travel age for a reptile as 11 weeks, meaning the earliest time this animal is allowed to fly. For cats, the crate can have a longest side of 61 cm, meaning the greatest length that fits within the required carrier size.

Arrive with your pet prepared for inspection and transport, and follow staff instructions promptly at the gate. Safety takes priority over speed on every journey, and guidance is concise, kind, and actionable.

If you need clarification, stop by the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you proceed.
